First Appeared: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1}
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.VxJKyJDX5JtaCOX7]{Crownvale}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson}

Description

@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson}'s ten-year-old daughter.
Precocious and sharp-eyed, she recognized @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} despite his disguise, calling him "Pappy" and identifying him by his feet.
She has a warm relationship with her great-grandfather.

Like Garland, she hears the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} — but where he hears only the slow grinding and moaning of the earth, Mira hears and understands them as actual words, and her touch makes the stones glow.
During @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland}'s return to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} she became dead-set on declaring herself his apprentice, attaching herself to him with a child's stubborn certainty.
Beneath that precociousness lies a deeper wound: the ruin that harmed Crownvale's children drove her into a deep depression, and it was then that she began hearing the stones' voices, which led her to the hidden Witch Stones, whose ancient magic started to heal her.

Role

She serves as an unwitting go-between, having delivered @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland}'s warning letter to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric}, and her connection to Garland makes her a focal point in the family's affairs.
She is an emerging cleric of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones}, hearing and commanding their words directly — a different and far more powerful connection than Garland's hard-won, study-built bond.
At the Witch Stones she spoke an unknown, booming tongue and commanded the stones to open a stable portal onto the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}, then stepped through it and left the Ashen Vale entirely, drawing Garland and Castor after her.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.WXUNMFUew0ikdeY3]{Aldric Garlandsson} — Her father
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland yn Greenholt} — Her great-grandfather, whom she calls "Pappy"; she has declared herself his apprentice, though he is the more reluctant party
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.crg1JpVHgdUHPdOO]{Castor} — Garland's great-grand-uncle and her distant kin; he has taken a liking to her despite her demanding nature; she calls him "Pop pop"

Key Events

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1} — Recognized Garland despite his disguise in Crownvale; received candy and a warning letter to deliver to Aldric
  • During the downtime after the curse — declared herself Garland's apprentice and revealed she hears the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Yaz5mCHyP6xdTwoc]{Witch Stones} as words
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — Sheltering with Garland at the Witch Stones to heal from the ruin that depressed her; spoke an unknown booming tongue and commanded the stones to open a portal onto the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}, then stepped through and left the Ashen Vale
